title: On Smelling the smoke before the dawn
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：smell　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 smell 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the foreman ① smelt the smoke before the dawn at once, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② smells the smoke before the dawn in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ smell the smoke before the dawn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ smelt the smoke before the dawn before — a line in the sheet for May 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Smelling the smoke before the dawn at once, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ smell the milk before paying in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Smell the milk before paying at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ smells the milk before paying at once every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ smelt the smoke before the dawn again when nobody else would.

⑩ To smell the smoke before the dawn, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody smells the smoke before the dawn in the rain again and somebody must smell the smoke before the dawn at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 闻到（一般过去式 smelt the smoke before the dawn：1965 年工头头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 闻到（一般现在 smells the smoke before the dawn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 闻到（不定式 to smell the smoke before the dawn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 闻到（过去完成时 had smelt the smoke before the dawn：1959 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 闻到（动名词 smelling the smoke before the dawn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 嗅（smell the milk before paying：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去嗅付钱前先把奶闻一闻）
G. v. 嗅（smell the milk before paying：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 闻到（后段两处：新来的工人照例 smells the milk before paying，而母亲又一次 smelt the smoke before the dawn）

answers.why: smell 意为“闻到”，1965 年工头二话不说地闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 smelt。
smell 意为“闻到”，自那以后工头淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 smells。
smell 意为“闻到”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味”，此处为不定式 to smell the smoke before the dawn。
smell 意为“闻到”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人闻到过，故用过去完成时 had smelt。
smell 意为“闻到”，工头说“闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 smelling the smoke before the dawn 作主语。
smell 意为“嗅”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去嗅付钱前先把奶闻一闻”，should ever 之后用原形 smell the milk before paying。
smell 意为“嗅”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻嗅付钱前先把奶闻一闻（smell the milk before paying at once），以后再也不要提起。
smell 意为“闻到”，新来的工人每个班次都照例嗅付钱前先把奶闻一闻，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 smells。
smell 意为“闻到”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味，用一般过去式 smelt 叙述。
smell 意为“闻到”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

多年以后，工头仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（smells the smoke before the dawn）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味这件事本身。（to smell the smoke before the dawn）
早在 1959 年就有人闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味，五月那天施工单上的一行字就是证据。（had smelt the smoke before the dawn）
工头说过，二话不说地闻到天亮前就闻到那股烟味这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（smelling the smoke before the dawn 作主语）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 smell 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the foreman smelt the smoke before the dawn at once, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman smells the smoke before the dawn in the rain whenever the site asks.
Smelling the smoke before the dawn at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever smell the milk before paying in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site smells the milk before paying at once every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother smelt the smoke before the dawn again, and the site remembered that half.
